skill.name: internal-comms
skill.description: Creates structured internal communications using templates for 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQ responses, and general company messages.

content.value_statement: Internal updates often need clear formats and consistent tone. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code draft newsletters, 3P updates, FAQs, and general messages.
actual_capabilities: Selects guideline files for 3P updates, newsletters, FAQs, and general internal messages.
Drafts concise 3P updates with Progress, Plans, and Problems sections.
Creates company newsletter drafts with sections for announcements, priorities, leadership, and social updates.
Formats employee FAQ responses as clear questions and short answers.
Guides context gathering from Slack, email, calendar, and documents when access exists.
Asks for audience, purpose, tone, and formatting when the request is unclear.
limitations: It does not verify source permissions or document confidentiality by itself.
It cannot replace legal, HR, executive, or communications approval.
It needs user-provided context when company systems are unavailable.
It does not enforce every company-specific policy or disclosure rule.

use_cases.title: Weekly Team 3P Update
use_cases.description: Turn team notes into a brief Progress, Plans, and Problems update for leadership review.

use_cases.title: Company Newsletter Draft
use_cases.description: Summarize major announcements, milestones, and leadership updates for Slack or email distribution.

use_cases.title: Employee FAQ Roundup
use_cases.description: Collect common employee questions and draft concise answers with links to trusted sources.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a 3P Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a 3P update for the Platform team covering last week and next week. Use these notes: [paste notes]. Keep it concise.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Company Newsletter
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a broad employee audience.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a company-wide newsletter for this month. Group the updates into clear sections and keep each bullet short. Use these source notes: [paste notes].

prompt_templates.title: Build Employee FAQs
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using questions and source material.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft employee FAQ answers from these questions and official source notes. Flag any answer that needs executive review before publication.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Leadership Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with tone, audience, and approval constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a leadership update for managers about [topic]. Use a direct tone, cite source links, exclude confidential details, and list approval questions.

output_examples.input: Notes for the Data team: shipped dashboard alerts, planning cost review, blocked by missing finance data.
output_examples.output:
📊 Data Team (July 1-7)
Progress: Shipped dashboard alerts for weekly reporting.
Plans: Complete the cost review with Finance next week.
Problems: Missing finance data is slowing final validation.

output_examples.input: Employees are asking when the office move happens and where to find seating plans.
output_examples.output:
Question: When does the office move happen?
Answer: The move is scheduled for next month. Employees should use the facilities announcement for seating plans and timing.

output_examples.input: Monthly company notes include product launch, new executive hire, customer milestone, and all-hands recap.
output_examples.output:
Company Announcements: Share the executive hire and all-hands recap first.
Progress on Priorities: Highlight the product launch and customer milestone with links.

best_practices: Provide source notes, audience, time period, and approval requirements before drafting.
Use official announcements and documents for sensitive or company-wide claims.
Review drafts for confidentiality, tone, and accuracy before distribution.
anti_patterns: Do not publish broad employee communications from unverified Slack threads alone.
Do not include restricted financial, HR, legal, or customer information without approval.
Do not use the newsletter format for detailed team task lists.

faq.question: What types of internal communications does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQ responses, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.

faq.question: Does it connect to Slack, email, calendar, or documents automatically?
faq.answer: No. It only guides the assistant to use those sources when the user has provided access through the active tool environment.

faq.question: Can it write a complete company newsletter?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure a newsletter with concise bullets, source links, and sections for major company themes.

faq.question: How should sensitive information be handled?
faq.answer: Sensitive information should be removed or approved before sharing. Use official sources and request review for uncertain claims.

faq.question: What information should I provide for a 3P update?
faq.answer: Provide the team name, dates covered, progress, next plans, problems, and important metrics.

faq.question: Can this skill be used with Codex and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
